checked_boundaries: Explicit memory-source schema2 metadata binds generator/helper filenames, payload kind and extractor format; legacy absence keeps schema1 policy.
normalize includes metadata/seed/generator/helper in sealed asset hashes; execute validation verifies assets and complete controller/helper/runtime inventories before admitted execution.

Generator is mounted with its single helper read-only; no whole bundle/oracle tree is introduced into preparation mounts. Runtime and adapter mounts remain read-only; only intended workspace/memory are writable.
Worker overwrites inherited PYTHONPATH, sets PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 and excludes workspace from trusted import paths. Generator and adapter helper provenance is now separated.

Generated seed must match exact frozen seed bytes before adapter preparation. Schema2 verify_memory requires exact catalog equality to validated frozen subject/tuple/source/span/policy data even if catalog and binding hashes were recomputed.
Catalog/source bindings are compared with canonical origin byte hashes/sizes after preparation; immutable seed/catalog/binding hashes are rechecked across trials.
Source payload remains source_excerpt_equals with exact expected literal and truncation; no note-header parsing or automatic manual-note conversion exists in this overlay.

Schema1 generator command, note comparison path and source consistency checks remain. Static command lacks state-home; CAMI alone receives its own state root. Static backend retains no ProductMemory service import requirement.

Existing fixed preparation limits remain: trusted source-only work, network none, 2 CPU/2GiB, per-command timeout300s, outer660s. These are not hard provider/billing, total host resource or validation-cost savings claims.

finding.control: PathFinder resolves two authored colliding literal_source modules to generator and adapter respectively without executing either fixture. Existing schema1 route has equal environments and no literal-generator path.
finding.effect: Adapter imports of literal_source could resolve the bundle helper instead of the source identified by the adapter runtime pins. Current helper byte identity did not make this a safe reusable boundary.
finding.fix: Separate per-command environments. Generator2 gets literal-generator first; adapter prepare gets only memory-adapter/cami-src/cami-deps. Worker logs only those trusted Python environment keys.
finding.trigger: Initial schema2 preparation reused one PYTHONPATH with /opt/literal-generator before /opt/memory-adapter for both generator and adapter prepare.

cases: Distinct actual module resolution per command
New helper mutation rejected by execute-time frozen source verification
Rehashed expected/span/kind tampering rejected and frozen seed unchanged
Schema1 original generator/backend state boundary preserved

limits: Actual generator/catalog2/container/MCP behavior is outside these pure review controls; root reports separate six-container success, not independently rerun here.
No real study data or heldout/task outcome inputs were inspected for this review.
Execution helpers assume the normal validated-study controller call path and trusted stable host code; this review does not establish adversarial host/filesystem immutability.
Schema2 supports only the declared Python literal predicate and bounded source/seed population; it makes no behavior, usefulness, token, cost or end-to-end speed claim.
scope: Independent read-only review of the four generic schema2 controller modules against the installed format-enabled baseline and preserved format-selection sources. Own controls use authored temporary fixtures only. No task bundle/outcome, heldout, model, Docker or source-target execution.
